Simply fry an egg until its nice and plump.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Omelets can be made by [[Cooking]] a [[Bird Egg]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. These dishes are common in [[Hyrule]], as making them only requires one to fry an egg until it is plump. Link can add several [[Ingredient]]s to Omelets, which can result in the following variations: * '''Chilly Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Omelet}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding chilly Ingredients. When consumed, Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Electro Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Omelet}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding electric Ingredients. By eating these, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Omelet}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding enduring Ingredients. Consuming them will completely restore and overfill Link's Stamina Wheel. * '''Energizing Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Omelet}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding energizing Ingredients. They can be eaten to refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Omelet}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hasty Ingredients. Link can eat them to receive a boost to his movement speed. * '''Hearty Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Omelet}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding hearty Ingredients. Eating them will heal all of Link's Hearts and temporarily increase his maximum Hearts. * '''Mighty Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Omelet}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding mighty Ingredients. They grant Link a boost to his attack power when eaten. * '''Sneaky Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Omelet}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding sneaky Ingredients. Eating them will boost Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Omelet}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding spicy Ingredients. When eaten, they will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. * '''Tough Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Omelet}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This simple dish is common all over Hyrule. Simply fry egg until it's nice and plump.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding tough Ingredients. If eaten, Link will receive a boost to his defense. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Recipe for an Omelet is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Each Step Like Thunder]]". It is made with five [[Bird Egg]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, it can be reduced to four. [[Cooking]] an Omelet before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] increases the amount of experience gained by the [[Warrior]]s by ten percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Omelet Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Omelet icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Omelets |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
